claim: Our goal was to basically try to replicate the services with the chatbot that we would provide with a human facilitator
asserter: Stacey Marz, Administrative Director, Alaska Court System

sources.story_title: Claim asserter and primary counter-evidence — Stacey Marz on the AVA chatbot built to replicate a human facilitator; same article documents the hallucinated non-existent Alaska law school, her walk-back, the 91 to 16 test-question cut, and the 18-plus-month overrun on a 3-month project.

sources.outlet: Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence / PubMed Central
sources.story_title: Counter-evidence — Rice et al. (Stanford, ANTHC, UAF, Southcentral Foundation, Maniilaq) on high-consequence AI deployment in Alaska needing community-engaged methodology; only 0.2 percent of 1,000-plus AI healthcare papers even mention community involvement.
